claims.evidence: Witness report notes no clear readable brand/model text on the frame in the photo.
No photo evidence about intended use; only bike appearance is described.
Front suspension fork is visible in the photo.
Drivetrain/cassette area is visible, but the exact gear system type/count is not confirmed.
No purchase date/receipt or markings visible in the photo.
Photo shows disc brake rotor and drivetrain presence, but no functional test results.
Photo does not show enough frame/metal surfaces to confirm absence of rust.
No component-level markings/serials are readable in the photo.

risks.risk: Brakes may not work properly (pads worn, rotor warped, hydraulic/cable issue) even though a disc rotor is visible.
risks.proof: A short video clip of a safe test: squeeze brake lever hard while stationary (front and rear), showing immediate bite and no rubbing/warping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a bicycle with untested brakes (worst case: needs brake service).

risks.risk: Gears may not shift smoothly (cable stretch, derailleur misalignment, worn cassette/chain) even though the drivetrain looks assembled.
risks.proof: A clip showing shifting through all gears while pedaling, with clear gear engagement and no skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a bicycle with unverified shifting (worst case: derailleur/cable/chain service).

risks.risk: Tires may be worn, cracked, or losing air; photo does not confirm tread depth or sidewall condition.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires (tread + sidewalls) and a quick pump/hold test or showing valve cap and no visible cracking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing tire replacement if tread/sidewalls are not confirmed.

risks.risk: Wheel/bearing condition may be poor (wobble, bent rim, bearing play) not visible from one angle.
risks.proof: A clip showing the wheel spin test (side view) and checking for wobble; also a photo of rim edges for dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as wheels/bearings unverified (worst case: truing or bearing replacement).

risks.risk: Frame may have hidden damage (cracks, bends, rust) not visible in the single photo angle.
risks.proof: Multiple photos: full frame (top tube, down tube, seat tube, fork crown), and close-ups of any joints/welds; plus a straight-edge check if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential frame issues (worst case: structural inspection needed).

risks.risk: Exact brand/model and size are unknown; wrong size reduces buyer value and resale.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any frame branding/serial and a measurement of seat tube (or size marking) plus stand-over height.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown size/brand (worst case: harder to sell).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the frame showing brand/model text (front and both sides) and any serial/size markings.
Provide a short video test: braking bite (front and rear) and no rubbing.
Provide a short video test: shift through all gears while pedaling (no skipping).
Send close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls on both wheels.
Send wheel spin/wobble check video and photos of rim edges for dents.
Send full-frame photos (all sides and fork) to check for cracks/rust/bends.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a blue road/fitness-style bicycle with front suspension and disc brake rotor visible, so it can be priced at its worst case for unverified condition. Seller claims about brand, age, rust-free status, and perfect function are not confirmed by the photo report.
